audit_after: the terminal, because the growth storage that rides with it moves no number on this name and the two are one rule's worth of evidence rather than two — the place to stop and look is once the terminal is on the sanctioned construction and before anything else is touched

levers.name: terminal built through the sanctioned module on a life DERIVED by identity from notes 9, 10 and 13; the retired reinvestment identity reported, never used
levers.why: the terminal carried 81% of enterprise value on rr = g/ROIC, which charges g x IC for ever and implies replacing the whole base every 1/g = 25.0 years. That is a fact about a 4% nominal terminal, not about a cable plant, and this base turns over in 35.76 years on the company's own notes. THE DIRECTION IS THE OPPOSITE OF EVERY EARLIER CORRECTION OF THIS DEFECT IN THIS PROGRAMME: in a pegged market 1/g charges too LITTLE, so the corrected terminal is higher and the answer moves AWAY from the price
levers.evidence: blended life 3,053,446,083 of gross cost over 85,395,637 of charge = 35.7565 years, the three charges summing to exactly the D&A this model carries; validated on the one leg with a single disclosed life, software at 14.43 derived against a stated 15; FY2024's own columns give 40.27, so the adopted reading is the shorter and heavier. Terminal 24,350 -> 24,919 (+2.34%)

levers.name: terminal growth stored as a REAL rate on the house Saudi path, nominal derived
levers.why: a typed nominal rate is unfalsifiable — nobody can tell whether 4% meant inflation plus two points or inflation minus one. Stored as +1.96% real on a 2.00% house terminal it recomputes to 4.00% to the basis point, so NOTHING MOVES and what a reader gains is sight of the claim: this business is assumed to grow about two per cent a year in real terms for ever
levers.evidence: the study's own prior review argued this correction was coupled to the terminal and could not ship, on the ground that zeroing the real growth would leave a 4.2-point convergence gap. The rule requires a stated real growth to be written down, not zeroed; the gap is unchanged at 2.2 points
